verdict.rationale: The only evidence of an in-product AI is a single homepage marketing line: "Describe what you want in plain text and let Bento's powerful AI build it for you." That suggests a built-in AI can generate assets from natural language, but nothing documents what it builds or how delegation works. The MCP server, CLI and Skills material serve external AI assistants, not a built-in one, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of the built-in assistant's scope (what it can build or do), how a user delegates tasks within the app, depth beyond one marketing claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
